description: This Java source file defines the CreateSubscription class which represents a command for subscribing to things in a search result within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and managing subscription parameters such as filter, options, fields, namespaces, and prefix.

classes.name: CreateSubscription
classes.description: A final class representing a command to subscribe to thing search results within Eclipse Ditto, allowing configuration of filters, options, fields, namespaces, and prefixes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CreateSubscription instance with specified filter, options, fields, namespaces, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a CreateSubscription object from a JSON representation and headers.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the filter string.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the options string.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the prefix string.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the set of namespace strings.

methods.name: setNamespaces
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated namespaces.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated prefix.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's parameters into a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the command with updated Ditto headers.
